title: A quiet ci-job step does not trip the stall watch and strand its jobs
why: Batch runner, batch 37 (#900), Oct 31 (via coordinator): a ci-job step quiet for over 300 s trips the stall watch; the stall exit leaves its jobs running, and the guard then refuses to stop them. Cost real time today.
note: Built Oct 31: draft PR #906 (with step ci-job-code-check-path), queued for batch 38 (coordinator, 16:41 CDT). The duplicate lane ci-job-stall-strands was stopped. Done check: a test with a step quiet past the stall limit ends with no process left running, red on main and green on the fix. Files: bin/ci-job, hooks/stall_watch.py.
